name: Construction Operations
description: Contractor workspace for main contractors and subcontractors: BIM IFC 3D viewer, visual AI archetype classification and Item Matrix estimation, hierarchical WBS planning with Autodesk ACC and P6/MSP sync, client contracts, subcontracts and VOs with PO, DO and invoice transactions, Business Partners, and WhatsApp/email intake.
description_zh: 面向总承包商与分包商的一体化工程工作区：BIM IFC 三维模型与视觉 AI 构件分类算量、支持 Autodesk ACC 与 P6/MSP 同步的层级 WBS 进度计划、客户合同、分包合同与变更单及采购单/送货单/发票台账、商业伙伴管理以及 WhatsApp/邮件自动同步。
